ex.s: Halfway down the page you realize that you have no idea what you have read. _____37_____ Thus, you go back and reread, not because you did not understand, but because you were not paying attention.
ex.t: 读到页面一半时，你意识到自己根本不知道读了什么。_____37_____因此，你会回过头重读，不是因为你没看懂，而是因为你没有集中注意力。

ex.s: I missed that paragraph because I was thinking of something else, but I’m going to keep on going and start paying close attention.”

ex.s: Rereading because you did not understand is a reasonable fix-up strategy.
ex.t: 因为没读懂而重读，是一种合理的补救策略。

ex.t: 如果你认为自己不需要围栏，因为你从没见过狐狸，那不妨想想：也许正是因为有了围栏，你才从没见过狐狸。

ex.s: We need the ability to work out which messes are worth avoiding — because however impressively fast you move, some things can’t be easily unbroken.
ex.t: 我们需要具备分辨哪些混乱值得避免的能力——因为无论你行动得多快，有些东西一旦打破就很难复原。

ex.s: This might be in part because of the difficulties of defining and measuring kindness.
ex.t: 这部分原因可能在于定义和衡量'善良'的困难。

ex.s: Because of this, I’m careful not to connect what my kids weigh with their worth as people.

ex.s: Completing many courses no longer brings out the feeling of success because more than four AP classes per year is a norm set by top universities.

ex.s: “I am ahead of my time.” If he seems a little defensive, it might be because even some of his coworkers occasionally laugh at his unusual methods.

ex.s: This makes sense because the people who get observational biodiversity data on mobile devices are often citizen scientists recording their encounters with species in areas nearby.
ex.t: 这样做是有道理的,因为在移动设备上获得观测生物多样性数据的人往往是公民科学家,记录他们在附近地区与物种的遭遇.

ex.s: So I absolutely think we will get more riders just because of short stories,” she says.
ex.t: 所以我绝对相信，仅因为短篇故事我们就会迎来更多乘客，”她说。

ex.t: 由于系统是自动化的，它大大减少了种植植物所需的水量。

ex.s: Many supermarkets are no longer doing “buy one get one free” promotions because of the   60   (criticize) that they lead to waste.
ex.t: 许多超市不再做'买一送一'促销活动，因为有人____60____（批评）这会导致浪费。

ex.s: Despite her encouraging smile, I wanted to sink through the floor because I was unsure about its pronunciation as well as its meaning.

ex.t: 因为我们是人，我们经常会失败。
